name: live-preview
description: Built-in live-reloading HTML preview (bundled - see extensions/build.mjs).

livePreview.autoRefresh.description: Automatically reload the preview when the HTML file or anything it loaded (stylesheets, scripts, images, fetched files) changes. Other files in the folder can change without reloading it.

livePreview.pollInterval.description: How often (ms) to check the previewed files for changes when auto-refresh is on.

livePreview.sendAutoSubmit.description: Submit a picked element's context to the agent immediately. Off (default) types it into the pane for you to review before pressing Enter.
